parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description:
The domain name for which to query custom headers.

> You can call the [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) operation to query all domain names.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group in Resource Management to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.
